name: GA4 Revenue And Traffic
citation: Google. BigQuery sample dataset for Google Analytics ecommerce web implementation — ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce (https://developers.google.com/analytics/bigquery/web-ecommerce-demo-dataset). Query tables `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` (Google Merchandise Store obfuscated GA4 event export, 2020-11-01..2021-01-31). Hosted via Google Cloud Public Datasets / BigQuery.
license: Google Cloud Public Dataset Program sample — provided for analysis via BigQuery; obfuscated demo data (not identical to the GA4 Merchandise Store demo account). Subject to Google Cloud / BigQuery public dataset terms; query costs may apply beyond free tier.
description: Covariate revenue. This bundle forecasts `daily_revenue_usd` from `percent_mobile_traffic` and `percent_paid_traffic`. Source: `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` — daily cadence, 92 rows, 2020-11-01..2021-01-31. Windows: context_window=35, forecast_horizon=7. Digital retail storefront funnel: pageviews / DAU / purchases / revenue; covariate task uses % mobile and % paid traffic mix.
preprocessing: 1. Source events from BigQuery public dataset ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce (or place pre-aggregated ga4_daily.csv in data/marketing/ga4/raw/).

2. Daily rollup SQL (see benchmark_build/README.md): PARSE_DATE event_date; COUNTIF page_view; COUNT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id; COUNTIF purchase; SUM purchase_revenue_in_usd; % mobile device.category; % paid traffic_source.medium ∈ {cpc,paid,ppc}.
3. transform_ga4.py: parse date → UTC day timestamps; numeric coerce count/revenue/% columns.
5. Fill missing count/revenue with 0; ffill/bfill traffic percentages then fillna 0.
6. Note: purchase_events counts purchase events (orders), not unique buyers; data are obfuscated so some fields are placeholders.
7. Write ga4_daily.parquet then TempusBench CSV (context_window=35, forecast_horizon=7 — constrained by short history).
